name: Centered Camera
description: Centres the player horizontally. The Game Boy screen is 10 tiles wide -- an even count, with no middle column -- so the ROM parks the player in column 4, which is 8 pixels left of true centre. This nudges the camera 8 pixels left so the player's tile straddles the centre line exactly, and it holds at any zoom, tilt or phone-fill view size because the offset rides the same follow the engine already scales. The vertical framing is left alone: 9 rows is odd, so row 4 really is the middle row and the ROM was already true there. X CENTRE sets the correction (8 = true centre, 0 = vanilla framing). Y NUDGE is an optional extra, off by default -- it fixes nothing, it just biases the view up or down if you want that.
